translations.literal: His faction in turn deceived and misled one another, until they had a host of more than ten thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: His faction in turn deceived and misled one another, until they had a host of more than ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 將出攻郡，襄先已帥民吏修城隍，爲備禦，及賊至，連戰破之，生獲琛，餘衆逃散。

translations.literal: About to march out to attack the commandery, Xiang had already led the people and officials in repairing the walls and moat for defense; when the rebels arrived he defeated them in successive battles, captured Chen alive, and the remaining host fled and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: About to march out to attack the commandery, Xiang had already led the people and officials in repairing the walls and moat for defense; when the rebels arrived he defeated them in successive battles, captured Chen alive, and the remaining host fled and scattered.

sentences.zh: 時鄰郡豫章、安成等守宰，案治黨與，因求賄貨，皆不得其實，或有善人盡室離禍，惟襄郡部枉直無濫。

translations.literal: At that time the defending officials of neighboring commanderies such as Yuzhang and Ancheng, in investigating and punishing accomplices, sought bribes on the pretext and none obtained the truth; sometimes good men had their whole households swept into calamity—only in Xiang's commandery were the wronged and the upright distinguished without excess.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the defending officials of neighboring commanderies such as Yuzhang and Ancheng, in investigating and punishing accomplices, sought bribes on the pretext and none obtained the truth; sometimes good men had their whole households swept into calamity—only in Xiang's commandery were the wronged and the upright distinguished without excess.

sentences.zh: 民作歌曰：「鮮于平後善惡分，民無枉死，賴有陸君。

translations.literal: The people composed a song: "After Xianyu was pacified, good and evil were divided; the people died without injustice—thanks to Lord Lu.
translations.idiomatic: The people composed a song: "After Xianyu was pacified, good and evil were divided; the people died without injustice—thanks to Lord Lu.

sentences.zh: 」又有彭李二家，先因忿爭，遂相誣告，襄引入內室，不加責誚，但和言解喻之，二人感恩，深自咎悔。

translations.literal: " There were also the Peng and Li households, who first quarreled in anger and then accused each other falsely. Xiang brought them into his inner chamber, applied no blame or reproach, but only with gentle words explained and persuaded them; the two men were grateful and deeply repented their faults.
translations.idiomatic: " There were also the Peng and Li households, who first quarreled in anger and then accused each other falsely. Xiang brought them into his inner chamber, applied no blame or reproach, but only with gentle words explained and persuaded them; the two men were grateful and deeply repented their faults.

sentences.zh: 乃爲設酒食，令其盡歡，酒罷，同載而還，因相親厚。

translations.literal: He then set out wine and food for them and had them enjoy themselves fully; when the wine ended they returned in the same carriage and thereby became close and warm.
translations.idiomatic: He then set out wine and food for them and had them enjoy themselves fully; when the wine ended they returned in the same carriage and thereby became close and warm.

sentences.zh: 民又歌曰：「陸君政，無怨家，鬥旣罷，仇共車。

translations.literal: The people again sang: "Lord Lu's governance—no families bearing grudges; when the fight ended, foes shared a carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The people again sang: "Lord Lu's governance—no families bearing grudges; when the fight ended, foes shared a carriage.

sentences.zh: 」在政六年，郡中大治，民李睍等四百二十人詣闕拜表，陳襄德化，求於郡立碑，降勑許之。

translations.literal: " In office for six years the commandery was greatly well governed; the commoner Li Xian and 420 others went to the capital to present a memorial at court, stating Xiang's moral transformation, and requested that a stele be erected in the commandery; an edict was issued granting permission.
translations.idiomatic: " In office for six years the commandery was greatly well governed; the commoner Li Xian and 420 others went to the capital to present a memorial at court, stating Xiang's moral transformation, and requested that a stele be erected in the commandery; an edict was issued granting permission.

sentences.zh: 又表乞留襄，襄固求還，徵爲吏部郎，遷秘書監，領揚州大中正。

translations.literal: They also memorialized begging to retain Xiang, but Xiang firmly sought to return; he was summoned as Director of the Ministry of Personnel, transferred to Director of the Secretariat, and concurrently Senior Rectifier of Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: They also memorialized begging to retain Xiang, but Xiang firmly sought to return; he was summoned as director of the Ministry of Personnel, promoted to director of the Secretariat, and concurrently senior rectifier of Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 太清元年，遷度支尚書，中正如故。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiqing he was transferred to Director of the Revenue Section and retained his rectifier duties as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiqing he was promoted to director of the revenue section and retained his rectifier duties as before.

sentences.zh: 二年，侯景舉兵圍宮城，以襄直侍中省。

translations.literal: In the second year Hou Jing raised troops and besieged the palace city; Xiang was assigned to serve directly in the Attendant-in-Chief Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Hou Jing raised troops and besieged the palace city; Xiang was assigned to serve directly in the attendant-in-chief office.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，城陷，襄逃還吳。

translations.literal: In the third year, third month, the city fell; Xiang fled back to Wu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, third month, the city fell; Xiang fled back to Wu.

sentences.zh: 賊尋寇東境，沒吳郡。

translations.literal: The rebels soon raided the eastern borders and overran Wu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels soon raided the eastern borders and overran Wu commandery.

sentences.zh: 景將宋子仙進攻錢塘，會海鹽人陸黯舉義，有衆數千人，夜出襲郡，殺偽太守蘇單于，推襄行郡事。

translations.literal: Jing's general Song Zixian advanced to attack Qiantang; at that time Lu An of Haiyan raised righteous arms with a host of several thousand men, sallied out by night to strike the commandery, killed the false administrator Su Danyu, and pushed Xiang to act in commandery affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jing's general Song Zixian advanced to attack Qiantang; at that time Lu An of Haiyan raised righteous arms with a host of several thousand men, sallied out by night to strike the commandery, killed the false administrator Su Danyu, and pushed Xiang to act in commandery affairs.

sentences.zh: 時淮南太守文成侯蕭寧逃賊入吳，襄遣迎寧爲盟主，遣黯及兄子映公帥衆拒子仙。

translations.literal: At that time the Administrator of Huainan, the Literary and Accomplished Marquis Xiao Ning, fled the rebels into Wu; Xiang sent to welcome Ning as league leader and dispatched An and his elder brother's son Yinggong to lead the host against Zixian.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the administrator of Huainan, the Literary and Accomplished Marquis Xiao Ning, fled the rebels into Wu; Xiang sent to welcome Ning as league leader and dispatched An and his elder brother's son Yinggong to lead the host against Zixian.

sentences.zh: 子仙聞兵起，乃退還，與黯等戰於松江，黯敗走，吳下軍聞之，亦各奔散。

translations.literal: Zixian heard that troops had risen and then retreated; he fought with An and others at Song River; An was defeated and fled, and the armies below Wu, hearing of it, likewise each scattered and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Zixian heard that troops had risen and then retreated; he fought with An and others at Song River; An was defeated and fled, and the armies below Wu, hearing of it, likewise each scattered and fled.

sentences.zh: 襄匿于墓下，一夜憂憤卒，時年七十。

translations.literal: Xiang hid beneath a tomb; in one night grief and anger overcame him and he died, aged seventy.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang hid beneath a tomb; in one night grief and anger overcame him and he died at the age of seventy.

sentences.zh: 襄弱冠遭家禍，終身蔬食布衣，不聽音樂，口不言殺害五十許年。

translations.literal: Xiang in his weak-capping years suffered household calamity; all his life he ate vegetables and wore plain cloth, listened to no music, and for some fifty years did not speak of killing.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang in his weak-capping years suffered household calamity; all his life he ate vegetables and wore plain cloth, listened to no music, and for some fifty years did not speak of killing.

sentences.zh: 侯景平，世祖追贈侍中、雲麾將軍。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing was pacified, Emperor Shizu posthumously appointed him Attendant-in-Chief and Cloud-Banner General.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing was pacified, Emperor Shizu posthumously appointed him attendant-in-chief and cloud-banner general.

sentences.zh: 以建義功，追封餘干縣侯，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: On account of his merit in raising righteous arms he was posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Yugan county with a fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: On account of his merit in raising righteous arms he was posthumously enfeoffed as marquis of Yugan county with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 陳吏部尚書姚察曰：陸倕博涉文理，到洽匪躬貞勁，明山賓儒雅篤實，殷鈞靜素恬和，陸襄淳深孝性，雖任遇有異，皆列於名臣矣。

translations.literal: Yao Cha, Director of the Ministry of Personnel of Chen, said: Lu Chui broadly penetrated literary principles; Dao Qia with his whole person was upright and firm; Ming Shanbin was elegant in Confucian learning and sincere and solid; Yin Jun was quiet, plain, tranquil, and harmonious; Lu Xiang was pure, deep, and filial in nature—though their appointments differed, all were listed among famous ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Cha, director of the Ministry of Personnel of Chen, said: Lu Chui broadly penetrated literary principles; Dao Qia with his whole person was upright and firm; Ming Shanbin was elegant in Confucian learning and sincere and solid; Yin Jun was quiet, plain, tranquil, and harmonious; Lu Xiang was pure, deep, and filial in nature—though their appointments differed, all were listed among famous ministers.
